messages:
maya: tiny experiment — everyone drop one ~3–5min obscure/90s B-side (or similar) + one short animated film (<=5m). i'll start: 'The Understudy — Paper Boats (1996) 3:12' + https://vimeo.com/12345678 (listen on headphones, tiny synth outro pairs with the hush of the short).
sam: love this. my pick: 'Junko & the Kite — Small Town Loop (1998) 4:05' + https://youtu.be/abcde — hand-drawn short, very low-fi vibes :thumbsup:
lee: i'm in. 'Martha Lane — Alley Whisper (1995) 3:47' + https://shorts.example/whisper — feels like walking home at 2am with a single streetlamp.
olivia: haha adorable thread. my rec: 'Felix Trio — Neon Coffee (1997) 2:58' + https://vimeo.com/feat/98765 — pairs with a tiny claymation coffee scene :coffee:
dave: anyone want keyboard-only recs? nominate: 'Kitchen Radio - Lull (1994) 3:01' + https://example.com/kitchen-lull — perfect for late-night background.
giphy: :giphy: <applause.gif>
maya: tiny poll idea — react with :one: for my pick, :two: for sam, :three: for lee, :four: for olivia, :five: for dave. i'll tally at 4pm PT.
sam: added to my offline playlist. great vibes already.
lee: can we make a follow-up thread with timecodes for the shorts? i can slice a watchlist.
olivia: weekend watch party? saturday 7pm PT :popcorn:
dave: i'm in if that's not past midnight my timezone.
maya: cool — i'll create a calendar invite and paste the collated playlist after tally. quick note: if you want your rec anonymized in the list, say so now.
lee: no anonymize needed. go wild.
olivia: pls include captions links if available (i need them).
sam: i'll add captions where i can.
maya: thanks! this is turning into the cutest tiny-festival. :sparkles:
